tools.name: resolve_property
tools.title: Resolve NYC property
tools.description: Normalize a NYC property to {address, bin, bbl, borough}. Give ONE of address, bin or bbl (bin and bbl may be given together to verify they match). Use this FIRST when you only have a street address, or to check that a BIN/BBL pair refers to the same property. Addresses need a house number and street, and a borough is strongly recommended. Input that names only a borough, city or zip code, an address that does not match the closest NYC address found, and an address that matches more than one building (e.g. the same address in two boroughs) each return an error listing the candidates and their BINs instead of a building. Not for fetching violations: use the get_*_violations tools or building_compliance_summary after resolving.

address.description: NYC street address including borough, e.g. "350 5th Ave, Manhattan".

bin.description: 7-digit NYC Building Identification Number (BIN), e.g. "1015862". First digit is the borough (1-5).

tools.name: get_dob_violations
tools.title: DOB violations for a building
tools.description: List NYC Department of Buildings (DOB) violations for one building by BIN, newest first. Requires a BIN: if you only have an address, or are unsure of the BIN, call resolve_property first. Use for the DOB record of a specific building (elevator, construction, work without permit, etc.). Not for ECB penalties/hearings (use get_ecb_violations), residential housing-maintenance violations (use get_hpd_violations), or an overview (use building_compliance_summary). Open/closed is a heuristic: open means "ACTIVE" appears in the record's category, and some "open" records are annotated as deleted (flagged per record). Responses are capped at ~12,000 characters, so a large limit can return fewer records (see `truncated`); recency lists contain dated records only (see `undated_excluded`).

bin.description: 7-digit NYC Building Identification Number (BIN), e.g. "1015862". First digit is the borough (1-5).

status.description: Filter by status: "open" or "closed" (any letter case). Omit for both.

tools.name: get_ecb_violations
tools.title: ECB violations for a building
tools.description: List DOB ECB (Environmental Control Board / OATH) violations for one building by BIN, newest first, including severity, hearing status and penalty balance. Requires a BIN: if you only have an address, or are unsure of the BIN, call resolve_property first. Use when the question is about penalties, hearings or amounts owed. Not for DOB violation records themselves (use get_dob_violations) or HPD housing violations (use get_hpd_violations). ACTIVE records with hearing status WRITTEN OFF are flagged per record. Responses are capped at ~12,000 characters, so a large limit can return fewer records (see `truncated`); recency lists contain dated records only (see `undated_excluded`).

bin.description: 7-digit NYC Building Identification Number (BIN), e.g. "1015862". First digit is the borough (1-5).

status.description: Filter by status: "open" or "closed" (any letter case). Omit for both.

tools.name: get_hpd_violations
tools.title: HPD housing violations for a building
tools.description: List HPD (Housing Preservation & Development) housing-maintenance violations (Class A/B/C) by bbl or bin, newest first. Use for residential conditions: heat, pests, leaks, etc. HPD covers residential buildings only: an empty result for a commercial building means no coverage expected, not compliance. Not for DOB or ECB records. If you pass both bin and bbl they must refer to the same property. A bbl covers the whole tax lot (possibly many buildings); a bin covers one building. Responses are capped at ~12,000 characters, so a large limit can return fewer records (see `truncated`); recency lists contain dated records only (see `undated_excluded`).

bin.description: 7-digit NYC Building Identification Number (BIN), e.g. "1015862". First digit is the borough (1-5).

status.description: Filter by status: "open" or "closed" (any letter case). Omit for both.

tools.name: building_compliance_summary
tools.title: Building compliance summary
tools.description: Best first call for "what is the violation situation at this property?". Takes ONE of address, bin or bbl and returns open vs closed counts per agency (DOB, ECB, HPD), the most recent issue date, the 5 most recent open items (one line each) and links to the source records. Makes 12 to 14 upstream requests (depends on the building) at 1 request per second, so a cold call takes at least about 11-13 seconds (measured 11-19 s). Use the get_*_violations tools afterwards only if you need full details of one agency. Counts DOB, ECB and HPD for the one resolved BIN (see `footprint`); read `data_quality_notes` first. Results are cached for an hour, so do not call it repeatedly for the same property.

address.description: NYC street address including borough, e.g. "350 5th Ave, Manhattan".

bin.description: 7-digit NYC Building Identification Number (BIN), e.g. "1015862". First digit is the borough (1-5).
